root_cause.text: l2cap_sock_ready_cb dereferences `chan->data` (the socket pointer) without first checking if it is NULL, leading to a null-pointer dereference when the socket has been cleaned up or not set.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `if (!sk) return;` check before `lock_sock(sk)`, and the crash trace shows `l2cap_sock_ready_cb` calling `lock_sock_nested` on a NULL pointer (address 0x260 in the KASAN report indicates an offset into `struct sock` from a NULL base).
